notes.title: December Patchnotes #1
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

the December patch is here! After the big 0.8 Version launch, we've been closely listening to your feedback, fixing bugs, and adding improvements based on your feedback on Discord!

Here are the fixes, additions & improvements for this month's patch: 

[list]
[*][b] 💾Added a new check to detect unsaved map changes when editing characters during map building:[/b]
Players will now get a warning to save their map changes when editing characters without fear of losing their map-building progress. This new safeguard ensures your hard work on maps remains intact, even if you need to tweak your miniatures mid-session.

[*] [b]🖌️Fixed an issue causing the map brush to get stuck when switching to the character editor:[/b]
Editing characters during map building will now behave as intended, disabling the brush inside the character editor.

[*][b]🔊 Adjusted sound mixing for the tutorial[/b]
Adjusted the loudness of various sound files during the tutorial mission.

[*][b]🧟 Reintroduced the Zombie Soldier and Undead Fighter miniatures to the map builder[/b]
Back by popular demand (or better said: fixed thanks to your reports)! The undead are once again available for all your necromantic (or apocalyptic) encounter designs. 

[*][b]🔧 Fixed a Bug where the character editor UI was sometimes not visible in VR[/b]
[/list]

We’re constantly working to improve the game and your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming! 
Stay tuned for more updates in future releases!

And as always: 
[b]See you inside Dungeon Full Dive![/b]

notes.title: Dungeon Full Dive: 0.8 is OUT NOW! + Biggest Discount of ALL Time
notes.content:
[h1]The Wait is Over![/h1]
We’re thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated 0.8 Update is officially here!

Packed with exciting new features, fresh assets, major improvements, and fixes, this update is brimming with content! Among the highlights are two major additions that you’ve been eagerly awaiting:

[b]1. The upgraded character sheets
2. The all-new tutorial mission[/b]

[h2]🎉 Celebrate with the Biggest Discount Ever! [/h2]
To celebrate the release of the 0.8 Update, the Game Master Edition has received its BIGGEST discount of all time—a massive 35% off!

If you’ve been waiting to upgrade your TTRPG adventures, now is the perfect time to dive in!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710740/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Game_Master_Edition/

But now without further ado - let's dive into the patchnotes!

[h2]📝Upgraded Character Sheets[/h2]
The character and monster sheets have received major upgrades in version 0.8!
Now, you can roll your attacks, actions, and spells with just one click—including monster actions!

Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*] [b]Select your action and press "Use":[/b] The roll-to-hit is automatically calculated for you.
[*] [b]Roll damage directly: [/b]After the to-hit roll, the result window allows you to roll damage (including automatic critical hit doubling!)
[*] [b]Shared Results: [/b]The results are posted in the chat for your party members to see.
[/list]
[i]Want to cast a spell? Just press "Use" to roll it instantly![/i]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/0fc501a74ea968e5e47e19ec2f6063be8455cbb2.gif[/img]

[i]Want to attack? Same process—just one click![/i]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/7e0f2c4814d67d19eaa86e3aa08270655ab6f0c2.gif[/img]

We’ve also improved all 5e monster sheets included in DFD to fully integrate with the new system. At the same time, we’re continuing to enhance DFD’s automation features so we look forward to your feedback!

[h2]🧝Beginner's Story[/h2]

With Update 0.8 we’re thrilled to release the [b]fully voice-acted[/b] DFD onboarding experience for mouse and keyboard!

This unique onboarding process is designed to introduce new players to the game, helping them learn the ropes in a short tutorial mission. But whether you’re a first-time adventurer or simply revisiting the basics: this onboarding mission will set the stage for your journey ahead!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/ab5c46f6696e2213fdc9d03980caa2482fdbde49.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/5cc78f4ecc31f0435ebe40ee08033e4e5b788236.jpg[/img]
[i]“We’ve also hidden some easter eggs throughout the onboarding experience. Will you be the one to find them all?”[/i]

[h2]✂️New Hairstyles[/h2]

[h3]The Stylish Hairstyle[/h3]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/07cd9697bfdecee702a4285149e4804c9851d12d.jpg[/img]
[i]"Some of you may die, but it's a sacrifice I am willing to make."[/i]
Evil lord or common villager? Either way, those stylish bangs will have heads turning!

[h3]The Untamed Hairstyle[/h3]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/0647d6eadbf0a13c9208d5711cdef3b63281510a.png[/img]
Feeling bold and confident? This untamed hairstyle adds a new edge to your characters!

[h2]🆕More Features, Improvements, and Fixes![/h2]

With the launch of the 0.8 Update, a wide variety of new features and improvements have been introduced. Here’s the full list:

[list]
[*] [b]Added a new map-saving system that detects changes automatically and asks you to save[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/16f6e154342baa95e07e19708e10e89305e9712b.jpg[/img] [i]Never lose your map-building progress again! This feature ensures your hard work is always saved.[/i]

[*] [b]Added an option for the terrain editing tool to avoid moving assets while terraforming[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/22f30a78d3eea68dd1b081767a8caef85803d589.jpg[/img] [i]Trying to create an overgrown ruin look? Now you can toggle whether assets move when using the terrain brush![/i]

[*] [b]Added the ability for spells to be cast at different levels[/b]
[i]Spells now use the correct spell slots and scale the damage dice accordingly, adding more flexibility to your spellcasting![/i]

[*] [b]Added a UI indicator in the character sheet to display the cost of an action[/b]
[i]Actions, bonus actions, and reactions are now clearly labeled for easier usability during combat.[/i]
[/list]

[h3]⬆️Additional Fixes and Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where placing one miniature would result in multiple miniatures being placed.
[*] Various UI design adjustments to improve readability and aesthetics.
[*] Fixed multiple UI overlapping issues.
[*] Improved menu flow in the main menu.
[*] Enhanced the visuals for dice-throwing animations and display text.
[*] Added a new help button that provides explanations for the currently open screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the possess tool displayed incorrect button descriptions.
[*] Corrected issues with monster sheets not displaying correctly or containing incorrect data.
[*] Fixed various character sheet-related issues where data was not loaded or saved properly.
[/list]

Thank you all for your incredible support! We’re excited to hear your feedback on Version 0.8. As always:

[h3][b]See you inside DFD![/b][/h3]

[h3]Discuss this update on Discord[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/e8FznWcyxk][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d776b95ce3951c6b6035941e94c532768f156bd1.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Get Ready for the BIG 0.8 Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Adventurer![/h3]
[hr]Get Ready![/hr]
[h1]⭐ Update 0.8 is JUST around the corner![/h1]

Update 0.8 is currently in the [b]final internal testing phase[/b], and the release is scheduled for THIS month!

Here’s what’s waiting for you in the 0.8 update:

[h2]📝 The New Character Sheets![/h2]

The character and monster sheets have received [b]major upgrades[/b] in version 0.8!
Now, you can roll your attacks, actions, and spells with just one click—including monster actions!

Here’s how it works:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/7e0f2c4814d67d19eaa86e3aa08270655ab6f0c2.gif[/img]

[h2]🧝 The New Beginner’s Story![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that the DFD onboarding experience will be [b]fully voice-acted[/b]!
This unique onboarding process introduces new players to the game and helps them learn the ropes.

We’ve packed a ton of improvements and fixes into 0.8. The full patch notes will be available on release day, but here’s a sneak peek:

[h1]🔔 When Exactly Will Update 0.8 Be Released?[/h1]

Update 0.8 is in its final testing phase and will be released [b]this month[/b]—specifically, within the next two weeks.

Stay tuned as we share more details in the coming days!

notes.title: Sneak Preview: The upcoming Update 0.8!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, Adventurer![/b][/h2]

Over the past weeks and months, we've been hard at work on [b]major new features[/b] and various improvements based on your feedback (yes, we're looking at you, Discord community!). Today, we're thrilled to [b]officially announce Update 0.8[/b]!

[hr][/hr]

[h1]🆕 What to Expect in Update 0.8[/h1]

[h2]📝 Rollable, Automated Attacks and Spells[/h2]

One of the most exciting additions in Update 0.8 is the introduction of [b]rollable Attacks and Spells[/b].


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/08b936d8c840a8a33e0cfb341802dc0f6a20f5ac.jpg[/img][i]Barbarians, rejoice! Even less math needed to play DFD![/i]
[list] 
[*]Want to roll an attack? Just press "Attack," and your proficiency is automatically calculated. 
[*]Need to roll damage? It’s just one click away! 
[*]Casting a spell? The damage roll is automatically determined based on the spell level! 
[/list]We are continuously working on the automation side of things for DFD and we are looking forward to hearing your feedback on these upcoming first steps towards this direction.

[h2]🧝A Singleplayer Mission for Beginners?![/h2]

Wait, what? Singleplayer? Can I now play DFD without a GM? Well... yes and no.

Based on the feedback from our recent Player Survey, [b]many of you have been asking[/b]  for a tutorial. So, in Update 0.8, we've prepared something special just for you:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/8bc4bc9039af933128b1bfed4756c9c7272f2ec9.jpg[/img]
We've added a [b]brand-new Singleplayer Beginner's Mission[/b] designed to provide new players with an excellent introduction to DFD and its tools!

For our seasoned players, we're also working on adding additional tooltips and information that can be accessed during gameplay.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]🔔When Will Update 0.8 Be Released?[/h1]

Update 0.8 is currently in full-force development, and we're aiming for a release in [b]Q4 this year[/b]—specifically, this November.

Stay tuned as we share more details as we get closer to the release date!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]What Else Can You Expect from Update 0.8?[/h1]

But wait… there's more! You can also look forward to:

[h3]🐺 New Miniatures[/h3]
[h3]🐺 New Character Assets[/h3]
[h3]...and yes, even more features waiting to be unveiled![/h3]

So, keep your eyes peeled on our social media and Discord for sneak peeks of what's to come in Update 0.8.

See you inside DFD!

notes.content:

Kicking off Q3 with a bang, we are incredibly excited to release the [b]new  0.7.2 Version[/b] for Dungeon Full Dive!

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Adventurer![/h2]
 
yes, yet another update is being released this week! ✨
 
With 4 new assets for the character editor as well as a variety of bug fixes & improvements, your next sessions this weekend are about to get even more versatile!

Here is what's in this week's update:

[h2]🎨 New Character Editor Assets[/h2]

[h3]2 new Hairstyles[/h3] 
A new hairstyle that will make your character become the main protagonist of the story. Available for both body types.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/3318c06131f4aa28775eda6eb7b8bc74025bb43e.png[/img]
[h3]2 new Faces[/h3]
Say hello to the old hag (or the friendly sage) with the new old face options for both male and female body types.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/50314cba59c08decc071679600b4293fde4f00db.png[/img]

[h2]⚙️ Improvements and Fixes[/h2]
[list]

[b]New Features & Improvements[/b]
[*] Maps can now save and load the mood & lighting setting that was set while saving the map file.
[*] Death saves have been added to the character sheets. They can be used when the HP of a character goes down to 0 and will correctly react to critical fail or saves. (They can also be added/removed manually)
[*] The LFG Button on PC now opens a confirmation popup before opening Discord
[*] Improved the collider on the "Rock" asset to be more precise.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the "Add to Combat" and "Remove from Combat" Button stopped working.
[*] Fixed the icons in the submenu tab for the Miniaturebrowser being offset in VR.
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the public game browser that would show 2 texts on top of each other for the first entry.
[*] Fixed a bug where miniatures could miss animations when possessed by a player that did not spawn them 
[*] Fixed potential map migration errors for map files that were created before the Chapter 3 release.
[*] Fixed a bug where objects could get stuck in other players' hands.
[/list]

[h2]🫵Your Review matters![/h2]
Again, thank you, everyone, so much for your feedback and your support over the last weeks, it truly means a lot to us! 
If you want to support the game, [b]please leave a review on our Steam Page[/b]. It helps us and the game [u]immensely[/u]!
 
Player Edition:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2839600/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Player_Edition/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2839600/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Player_Edition/[/url]
GM Edition:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710740/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Game_Master_Edition/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710740/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Game_Master_Edition/[/url]
 
And always:

[b]See you inside Dungeon Full Dive![/b]

notes.title: May Update #2 Version 0.7.1-482
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Adventurer![/h3]

Another week, another update ✨! 

As our community continues to grow, we've been closely listening to your feedback and bug reports. We've been actively engaging with everyone on our [url=https://discord.gg/e8FznWcyxk]Discord[/url], answering questions & comments, and of course, exchanging with our [b]fantastic community members.[/b]

[h2]💰Player Questionnaire: Win 20$![/h2]
We love to hear all your thoughts & feedback and to give everyone the chance to participate we have just released a new Player Questionaire for DFD and its development roadmap. 
Participate now to [b] shape the future of DFD[/b] and to secure your chance to [b]win a 20 $ Steam Gift Card[/b]! (One random participant will be selected).

[url=https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=bljfwshOhE2ZPmn9l5HkH6VRkJPcaeVHkvEu-QrZQUFUQjhVREJaOU9GSEpYMkM2Q1BIQ1pBVEcwTy4u][b]<<Take the Survey>>[/b][/url]

At the same time, our dev team has been hard at work to resolve any potential issues and to improve your player experience. So, we're thrilled to unveil yet another update just in time for your upcoming weekend gaming sessions!

Here is what's in this week's update:

[h2]🗺️ A New Map: Breeze Islands[/h2]

[i]"Breeze Island" is a tiny Island notable for its many Windmills. A small market and mountainous terrain offer a good starting point for some adventuring.[/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/5477230c8b255a6a19dae688d3e29439302531d1.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/c6968b4e7c0a61d8337d091b2579f10ccd0144c2.gif[/img]

[h2]⚙️ Improvements and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[b]UI / UX[/b]
[*] Improved sorting logic for entries of the Map Browser.
   My Maps Tab: Entries are now sorted by last changed ascending.
   Official Map Tab: Entries are now sorted by name ascending.
   Public Map Tab: Entries are now sorted by likes descending.

[*] Improved sorting logic for entries of the Character Browser
   My Characters Tab: Entries are now sorted by last changed ascending.
   Official Characters Tab: Entries are now sorted by name ascending.

[*] Added a new Info Popup when attempting to access character sheets of miniatures, that are owned by other players.
[*] Improved the "unavailable" message inside the context menu "Full Dive" option, when attempting to Full Dive into a miniature that is not available for Full Dive,

[b]Charactersheet[/b]
[*] Corrected the AC Calculation for heavy armor
[*] Corrected the AC calculation for unequipping armor

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug where the context menu could become non-responsive (for example after deleting a map asset)
[*] Fixed some floating assets on the "Elder Dragon Lair" Map.
[*] Fixed some floating assets on the "Winter Festival" Map.
[*] Fixed a Bug where the hover outline of a miniature could get stuck (after Full Dive).
[*] Fixed a Bug where players were able to Full Dive into miniatures using the context menu even if they were missing rights.


[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[*] Updated the in-game newsboard with the new player survey.

[/list]

As always thank you for playing, we hope you enjoy your time in DFD and we look forward to hearing your feedback, thoughts, and ideas!

[b]See you inside Dungeon Full Dive![/b]

notes.title: May Update #1 Version 0.7.1-481
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Adventurer! [/h1]

This is our first larger patch after the first week of the launch of the Player Edition!

First and foremost we want to say "Hello" to all the new players: 
Thank you for playing DFD, for bringing in your new ideas, for your awesome interactions on our discord, and of course for all of your feedback! 

[b]If you are looking for party members to play DFD with, remember to join our Discord![/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/e8FznWcyxk][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d776b95ce3951c6b6035941e94c532768f156bd1.gif[/img][/url]
⭐ To all @GMs: This is YOUR time to shine! Find new Players and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1710740/view/4216006291758937798?l=english]get a free Lorekeeper Diceset![/url]⭐[/b]

Having said that, let's get into this week's content:
[h1]🗺️New Assets![/h1]

[h2]1. New Map: Highland Ruins[/h2]
We have added a brand new map to the official map tab called "Highland Ruins".

[i]In the "Highland Ruins" a mountainous path leads to an ancient ruin that isn't as uninhabited as it initially seems.[/i]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/73bd1c10b64a41659fd2ecc15c87b3b5d1c2936b.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/03ef91d25e82e933c4a1e158820660fc6a53f617.gif[/img]
[h1]🎥  BONUS [/h1]
[h3]Watch the creation process behind "Highland Ruins"[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you want to see the creation process behind the map and also get some [b]neat map-building tricks [/b] from the devs, you can check out our art team's creation process behind the map over here:
[previewyoutube=p4DLbISjQII;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[/list]


[h2]2. New Map: Elder Dragons Lair[/h2]

[i]Expanding on the "Vulcano Map", the "Elder Dragons Lair" Map is the final confrontation with an ancient beast. Multiple paths lead through these dangerous crumbling ruins in the midst of a volcano. The ultimate test of bravery and perseverance![/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/053caf6edfa73e47345f893b2cf0ba4483d0e40e.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/ce78a828ae50e59f8f6e5179adfb924beda4f80d.gif[/img]

[h1] 🔧 Fixed Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where players could get scorpion legs after map change if they were crawling during the map change
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44910592/ee76ff2dd838315844db25f1d1a4cdcbca8e9caf.gif[/img]
[*] Fixed dice, rolled by tabletop players still generating sound effects even when you're in Full Dive mode and unable to see them.
[*]Fixed a rare bug where the hover HP bar could be visible in the main menu
[/list]

Thank you so much for playing DFD. Without you, none of this would be possible and your support is what allows us to bring DFD to the next level! 

[b]See you inside DFD![/b]

[b]P.S. What maps do you want to see in the next update? Let us know down below in the comments![/b]

notes.title: 📢Chapter 3 is OUT NOW! 📢
notes.content:
[h2]Chapter 3 is out now![/h2]

Greetings Adventurer and Welcome to Chapter 3! 

As always, this update was made based on your feedback and we're excited to show you all the changes, new features, and improvements that made it into this first update of Chapter 3!

Before we dive deep into the details of Chapter 3, we wanted to say a big thank you for your support!

[h2]🆓Free Player Edition[/h2]
Also, don't forget that starting with chapter 3 (on the 12th of April), all Players can [b]start playing for FREE[/b] by downloading the [b]Player Edition[/b]! 

Learn more about the free Player Edition over here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2839600/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Player_Edition/

[h1]🆕 What’s New in Chapter 3?[/h1]

[h2]🎲New Features[/h2]
[h3]Miniature Overview List[/h3]
As a GM, the Miniature Overview List allows you to easily keep track of all the miniatures on the table. With it, you can now:
[list]
[*] Jump to the location of miniatures
[*] Keep track of HP of miniatures
[*] Quick-Access character sheets
[*] Quick-Access Full Dive
[*] Quickly add & remove miniatures to the Combat Initiative
[/list]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/ae7023ca1191af716b3b6e5e5c256b1c80406bf9.gif[/img]
For players (Non-GMs), this list is automatically filtered to only display the party members.
[h3]New Healthbar System in Tabletop Mode[/h3]
The new system for healthbars now only displays HP bars in tabletop mode when hovering over a miniature.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/58d5b9341b926f8479709b8340ff9be7ec905f40.gif[/img]
As a GM you can switch between the following settings for your Players:
[list]
[*] [b]Full For All:[/b] All Players (Non-GMs) can see the HP bar on hover, including the exact number values.
[*][b] Exact Numbers Only For GM:[/b] Players will only see the HP bar but no exact numbers
[*] [b]Only For GM:[/b] Players will have no info displayed when hovering miniatures
[/list]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/77792f5e7e1e9ed5ac6051f45a0db1e6e91e1c71.jpg[/img]
[h3]Undo / Redo Tool for Mapbuilder[/h3]
The highly requested Undo/Redo Tool has been added to the mapbuilder! It allows you to undo OR redo your last map building actions. 
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/a23abb7acd4466fa5c97adea9b215d90427116fc.gif[/img]
[h3]Customizeable World & Player View[/h3]
A new setting has been added to the options: With the world & player visibility setting you can now choose to hide the table and/or the other players depending on your personal preferences.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/037bfe00c986dfb12db0ca2db993b0543289b1d2.gif[/img]

[h2]⚙️Improved Code Modding Support[/h2]
[list]
[*]The coding backend of DFD has been changed from IL2CPP to Mono for better mod support. [*]Additionally, a first wiki on how to mod DFD was created You can check it out over [url=https://dungeonfulldive.notion.site/Dungeon-Full-Dive-Modding-6667f2dda86845559a44011507ca9825?pvs=4]HERE[/url].
[/list]
[h2]🎵New Music[/h2]
A new dynamic song has been added to the soundboard! As always, it includes 3 levels of intensity for your GM to dynamically adjust depending on the flow of the campaign. 
[olist]
[*] Tavern Music
[/olist]
[h2]🎨New Assets[/h2]
[h3]New Wizard Outfit for humanoid species[/h3]
The new wizard outfit is here! It includes a new hat, a new chest piece, new gauntlets, and new boots!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/f0c48c375fec079ab3763d199d04e55753651d39.jpg[/img]
[h3]6 Clothing Sets for Dragonborns[/h3]
Six new clothing sets have been added for the Dragonborn species! 
[i][b]Disclaimer: [/b]Dragonborn characters that have been created before the Chapter 3 Update must be reconfigured in the Character Editor to work correctly with the new version of the game.[/i]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/00f730473765713553fc0010dd2efb636af1546a.jpg[/img]
[h3]8 new eye sets for Dragonborns[/h3]
Eight new eye sets have been added to the Dragonborn species,
[h3]2 new horns for Dragonborns[/h3]
You can now choose between two different sets of horns as Dragonborn. 
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/49cea42a245daa6b757bf7f7f1dbc98122a8da94.jpg[/img]
[h3]New GM Dice Set[/h3]
As part of the GM Edition Upgrade, all Players have been rewarded with the GM Edition exclusive "Game Master" Dice set. 
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d84b2c6c09e7f804eb19408b0ddf62d14550fea3.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Lorekeeper Dice Set[/h3]
A new dice set has been added that can be [b]unlocked for free[/b] by participating in the lorekeeper community event. 
You can check it out over [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1710740/view/4216006291758937798]HERE[/url].
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/87e72117b7497b1d01721356641007bddca943e1.jpg[/img]
[h1]🛠️ Additional Improvements [/h1]
We have also been doing a lot of miscellaneous improvements on existing features as well as bug fixes. Here is the complete overview of the changes and fixes:
[h2]Additional Improvements[/h2]
[list]
    [*] New Main Menu design, Play Screen design, animation & music
    [*] Improved smoothing brush for terraforming
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/3541d944228586722fbf6b8d4b8dea813bf7757b.gif[/img]
    [*] Added new sound effects for the character editor, map building, UI interactions, and item usages
    [*] While in tabletop mode PC players are now prevented from going too far out of bounds. 
    [*] Added an indication when players are attempting to mapbuild outside of the current table area
    [*] Dice are now bigger in PC & VR and scale with you in VR
    [*] Added animation when placing map assets
    [*] TOTW Oneshot maps are now marked as official

[/list]
[h2]Resolved Bugs[/h2]
[list]
    [*] Fixed characters not correctly reacting to the light depending on the selected mood setting
    [*] Fixed duplicate ID issues on official maps which caused network interactions not to be shown correctly for certain objects
    [*] Fixed terrain issues where terrain disappeared after going into full dive from terraforming
    [*] Fixed frame lags in Miniature Browser & Map Browser UIs. You can now browse the mapbrowser even while it's loading new maps.
    [*] Fixed character sheet unintentionally opening when writing in chat
    [*] Fixed Voice Chat Indicator overlay not correctly showing in PC
    [*] Fixed an issue where the only available character was a bear and no new characters could be created
[/list]

[h1]❤️ Thank you[/h1]

We've really put our hearts into the first update of Chapter 3, wanting to make it something special. But honestly, we couldn't have done any of this without your support. So, a huge thank you from all of us here. Your support is what keeps us going and makes all the difference in pushing DFD to the next level!

[b]See you inside Dungeon Full Dive![/b]

[h3]Discuss this update on Discord[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/e8FznWcyxk][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d776b95ce3951c6b6035941e94c532768f156bd1.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Announcing: Chapter 3!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Adventurers,[/h3]
[b]This April is packed with content for Dungeon Full Dive![/b] 
We're not only opening the gates to the [b]DFD: Player Edition[/b] on April 12th but we are also incredibly excited to announce, that a brand new chapter: [b]Chapter 3 will be rolling out on April 11th![/b]  Get ready for an adventure-packed month!

[h2]⭐Announcing Chapter 3⭐[/h2]
Chapter 3 will be introducing a whole new slate of enhancements and new features, from [b]official mod support to fresh character assets and a brand-new GM tool[/b], there's plenty to explore. We'll share a detailed breakdown of all the new features soon, but here's a glimpse of what's to come in Chapter 3’s [b]first [/b](of many) [b]updates[/b]:

[h3]🔧 Modding[/h3]
We're making modding more intuitive and expansive by switching from [b]IL2CPP to Mono[/b], alongside publishing [b]official modding guidelines[/b]. Join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/4Wsq47EstH]here[/url] to start diving into discussions, access documentation, and help us create the future of DFD (More modding announcements coming soon!).

[h3]🛠️ New GM Tool[/h3]
Master your campaigns with new features to the [b]Miniature Overview List[/b], aimed to provide GMs with powerful control and overview over all the miniatures.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/15d583589b33fc739d88009b69814d2fee6a54d9.png[/img]

[h3]⚙️ Feature Improvements[/h3]
We're committed to making DFD as easy to play as possible. Chapter 3 introduces[b] new, advanced tools [/b]and improvements to the [b]map builder, HP Bar System[/b], and more, making DFD more accessible and enjoyable for everyone. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/9fb653475ffc7f9c02082fc43d091f71181c5202.gif[/img]

[h3]🎨 Hot New Character Assets:[/h3]
Refresh your party's look with our latest collection of [b]dragonborn clothing[/b] and get a sneak peek at the mystical [b]new wizard outfit[/b] for the first update! Chapter 3 is about to get magical!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/e15be97ba426a9517e096815b2f4483aea3f03e6.png[/img]

[h2]🎉 And There’s More! - Introducing the DFD: Player Edition 🎉[/h2]
For those who might have missed it, the [b]DFD: Player Edition[/b] is our upcoming [b]FREE version of Dungeon Full Dive[/b], designed to throw open the gates of adventure to everyone! Experience the magic of DFD, craft your saga, and join tabletop sessions all [b]at absolutely no cost[/b]. 

Wishlist it over here to stay up to date: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2839600/Dungeon_Full_Dive_Player_Edition/

[h2]🗺️ Join Us on This Epic Journey![/h2]
Mark your calendars for these back-to-back launches! Wishlist the Player Edition now and stay tuned for more details and updates coming in Chapter 3 of Dungeon Full Dive.

As always thank you so much for your support! The adventure continues, and we’re thrilled to have you with us every step of the way!

[b]Looking forward to seeing you inside DFD,[/b]

notes.title: Chapter 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]This is it.[/h1]

[h2]Chapter 2: The GM Update is [b]out now for everyone[/b] to play![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710740/Dungeon_Full_Dive/

Chapter 2 is DFD’s [b]most ambitious and biggest update[/b] yet. This update was made based on your feedback and requests and there are a LOT of changes, new features, and improvements.

So much, that Rachel and Lyria have even prepared [b]a special video for you all[/b] just for this update and to go over what’s new in Chapter 2.

So be sure to check it out!

[previewyoutube=HlDA3aURJ44;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]🎉 Celebrate with 20% Off & Free Player Demo![/h1]

Before we dive deep into the details of Chapter 2, we wanted to say a big thank you for your support!

As a thank you and to celebrate the kickoff of chapter 2, we're offering an exclusive [b]20% discount on DFD until next week only (December 11th)[/b]!

Plus, don't forget that you can have a sneak peek of Chapter 2 with your entire party by downloading the [b]Free Player Demo[/b]. Unsure yet if you want to dive in with the whole group? Only during December, you have the chance to experience the excitement of DFD for free! Learn more about the limited demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1710740/view/3904119881299041920][here][/url].

[h1]🆕 What’s New in Chapter 2?[/h1]

[h2]🎲New Features[/h2]

[h3]Music & Ambience Board[/h3]
[previewyoutube=YdTDa8FbVYE;full][previewyoutube=YdTDa8FbVYE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
You can now add music and ambience sounds to your game with our new Music & Ambience Board. On top of that: Each ambience and music track also has an intensity slider so you can customize your listening experience:

A little rain can turn into a massive storm, or distant wolf howls can suddenly feel like they're right next to you.
Is your party low on health and about to go down? Crank up the intensity! The music changes at your demand.

[h3]Fog of War[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/fdd297b36997874d27bce55a5378206affe10585.gif[/img]
You can now add Fog of War to your Maps to hide enemies or map parts. As a GM these blocks are see through but as a player they are pitch black …until a player moves their miniature inside it that is.

[h3]Animations in Tabletop Mode[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/13947a0d90b8ae66b4e786d8880e12cb640c113e.gif[/img]
We have now added the ability to show animation even when in tabletop mode. This means your GM can now stay in full control in tabletop mode while still seeing what the party is up to.

[h3]Initiative Tracker & HP Bars[/h3]
The new Initiative tracker allows your GM to start an encounter at any time. By pressing the “Start Combat” button inside the new miniature overview tab. This will open the “Combat Preparation” Window where all participants for the encounter can be selected.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/4834ff07685ff5b6d24672e419df585012a4102b.jpg[/img]
Starting combat will spawn the Initiative Tracker for everyplayer. In here the GM can go through the turn order by using the “End Turn” Button.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/0eaa1481c079b7b3975571577050f5afa56fbbaa.jpg[/img]

[h3]HP Bars[/h3]
We have also added the ability to show HP bars so that you can easily keep track of the HP of all miniatures on the board.
This setting can be configured under the “Settings” menu in the Pause Menu. Here you can currently toggle between enabled and disabled. (More settings are planned)
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/0ddd28ac75e3d41fe652210b7d1b78c650405401.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/46b838f7a37ced5d6a60e3dad3a96d8ab2a6672a.png[/img]
[h3]Enhanced Character Sheets[/h3]
Dive deeper into your character's capabilities with the new improved Character Sheet, now displaying your:

[list]
[*]Class / Species
[*]Actions & Abilities
[*]Spells
[*]Equipment
[/list]

[b]Spells[/b]
In the new spells tab, you can now manage your character's spells. The spell sheets include the entire 5e OGL spell library for you to use. And: You can also cast spells directly from the tab, which automatically tracks your spell slots for you and shares the spell descriptions with your party in the chat.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/12640ca23f85c7c592999e4cb30ec9a0079fe08e.jpg[/img]

[b]Actions, Features & Traits[/b]
The new actions tab lets you keep track of all the actions your character can unleash individualized based on your character class and equipped gear.
Also, you are able to look at the features & traits provided by your class and species.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/6ae58beca877b57c03b2029d592f5c237798d4f0.jpg[/img]

[b]Inventory[/b]
In the Inventory page, you can manage your character’s equipment as well as keep track of your parties gold.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/784b5dbc03e098943683e098a4da9eac0afb6674.png[/img]

[b]Stats Page Overhaul[/b]
We have improved the current stats page: You can now select your class, subclass as well as species and subspecies. On top of that, we have also polished the general UI Design.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/834d254de348424f4da0f8843e5311275ce0c55d.jpg[/img]

[b]Character Customization[/b]
Next to the content of the 5e OGL library (using the https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document), you are able to add your own content to the game as well!
For more info and an in-depth explanation, we will be adding tutorials in the following days over [url=https://dungeonfulldive.notion.site/Modding-8b7b878c1d764a3d92f84c859c609a6b?pvs=4]HERE[/url].

[h3]Jumping[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d59e02a805bbffa7e93d0d6a7764663a3a109ad1.gif[/img]
Hep Hep, you can now jump inside DFD when Full Diving. We look forward to the first parcour maps!

[h3]Instruments[/h3]
The following instruments are now playable in VR and on PC:
[list]
[*]Horn
[*]Harp
[*]Lute (Improved Audio)
[/list]

[h3]Body Sliders[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/b43f3c7b05e8ad1c6f7a1fb966aaa9632260f233.gif[/img]
You can now customize the body parts of your character using the new body slider tab! From long-necked wizards to chonky Barbarians, let your imagination go wild!

[h2]🎨New Assets[/h2]

[h3]Dragonborns[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/ca9aa28a14f80637885e22b6ea45a2afb0d2ee63.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/13b2567ba3074ea186e0ad45a1ad2a95767edeb5.png[/img]
(Hello STRG + F “Dragonborn” People)
We have now added the Dragonborn species to DFD with 2 presets for the masculine and feminine body types. We are also working on additional customization options for the Dragonborn so stay tuned!

[h3]Custom Colors?[/h3]
If you want to customize your character’s appearance even more, you can now change the available skin colors within the config files.
For a detailed tutorial, check out our tutorial [url=https://www.notion.so/dungeonfulldive/Modding-Character-Data-8b7b878c1d764a3d92f84c859c609a6b]HERE[/url]

[h3]New Monsters[/h3]
2 new miniatures have been added to the game with the Gecko and the Flying Viper
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/ff7314fea02bcbbd2ef584471022115e751aa4f4.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/a33b56554fcb6a2cd21052dafa10042008c2df79.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Maps[/h3]
[b]Hell[/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/5c0b6566bced84f6917d44f94d7b8c6a97246b71.png[/img]
We have added a new hell map for you to explore as well as a “Lava” Terrain Template for you to use. 
[b]Dungeon[/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/c6d0620018a0187d3a06056b95a8d2da81818e6d.png[/img]
A new dungeon map has been added and can be explored by your party.

[h1]🛠️ Additional Improvements & Features[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Map Performance ranks have been added. This will show the total amount of map assets used in a map as well as a performance indicator.
    [*]Configure your own skin colors
        [olist]
            [*]Go to \DungeonFullDive_Data\StreamingAssets\Characters\SkinTones
            [*]Open "colors.ini" & change the HEX code of one of the colors (this will replace the previous color on said spot)
        [/olist]
    [*]The Sidebar UI is now aware if you are GM or player and will update the visible menus accordingly. The following tabs are only accessible by the GM:
        [olist]
            [*]Map Settings & Loading
            [*]Soundboard
            [*]Miniature Overview
            [*]GM Notes (TOTW Oneshot PDF)
        [/olist]
    [*]The Context Menu can now be opened outside of Map Builder
        [olist]
            [*]The character sheet of a character can be accessed via Context Menu
        [/olist]
    [*]You can now use your Character Editor characters as NPCs as well
    [*]Added Female dwarf armor
    [*]You can now move in VR in the Character Editor
[/list]

[h1]🐞 Resolved Issues[/h1]

We have also been doing a lot of smaller improvements on existing features and bugfixes. We are still working on collecting all of these smaller changes and will update the list over here in the next couple of days:

[list]
    [*]Fixed missing preview pictures of characters, maps & assets
    [*]Flamables can now be on by default
    [*]Minis who are saved on maps are no longer destroyed on reload
    [*]Fixed second monitor staying open when using Streamer camera
    [*]Nameplates are no longer visible while in Character Editor
    [*]Disabled scaling of remote characters in Tabletop mode as it caused a number of issues
    [*]Fixed networking issues when late joining players moved miniatures
[/list]

[h1]❤️ Thank you[/h1]

Our team has poured heart and soul into making [u]the first update[/u] of Chapter 2 as extraordinary as possible.
But none of this would have been possible without your amazing support.
So thank you: Your support is what allows us to push DFD to the next level!

[b]See you inside Dungeon Full Dive![/b]

[h3]Discuss this update on Discord[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/e8FznWcyxk][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d776b95ce3951c6b6035941e94c532768f156bd1.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Announcing Chapter 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42258170/3b409ca36f225d3d3c00ecce379b76b02b20e8ec.png[/img]
It's time to talk about roadmap.

We've heard your tales, we've listened to your feedback and we've shared our development plans with you. Meanwhile, we've also been working on our [b]most ambitious and biggest updates[/b] yet. So, we're extremely excited to announce:

[h1]✨Chapter 2 is coming!✨[/h1]

[b]Chapter 2 is all about bringing the best possible experience to your GMs & making it as easy as possible for you to play your favorite TTRPG![/b]

With Chapter 2 we are focusing on adding features and improvements that allow you to play and most importantly [b]host[/b] your tabletop games as easily as possible. 
This includes [b]new GM tools, deeper stat integration for 5e[/b], and of course [b]more TTRPG features[/b]!
At the same time, we want to push what is possible inside DFD by bringing you [b]more assets, new species[/b], and many other [b]new features[/b] that you have been asking for!

[h1]The Three Pillars of Chapter 2[/h1]

[h2]🛠️1. GM Tools[/h2]
Prepare yourselves for brand new Game Master controls! We're giving your GMs a variety of new tools to control the campaigns, adjust the flow of play, and navigate through combat. Exciting features await as your GM takes control of the story with new and improved features such as [b]Fog of War[/b], [b]Advanced Miniature Management[/b], and much more!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/92b9b345047f7f56dc434b8b254f9bf1afb3eac5.gif[/img][i]What could be hiding here? A small Teaser of the upcoming Fog of War Tool.[/i]

[h2]⚔️2. Basic Combat[/h2]
Combat is a cornerstone of every tabletop session, so we are adding new tools to make combat even more enjoyable for the whole party! New features like [b]Automated Initiative Tracking[/b] will make your Combat sessions focus on the action instead of lengthy calculations. At the same time, our new [b]Character Sheets[/b] and the inclusion of [b]ALL the 5e Monster Stat Sheets[/b] in the OGL will give you and your GM complete access to every information that you'll need while fighting through your encounters! Take a first step into the exciting realm of combat with us and we look forward to your feedback as you charge into your battles inside DFD!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42258170/8bdf12595c060262ffcfd35492f82b9dba38c335.png[/img][i]Behold my mighty Spell Book! The current Design of the Spells Tab.[/i]

[h2] 🐉3. EVEN MORE Variety [/h2]
We want every player to completely immerse themselves in their campaign like never before. So, we are adding new [b]battle maps[/b], even [b]more map assets[/b], and new features to [b]make your worlds more interactable while Full Diving[/b]. At the same time, we are also giving players brand [b]new ways to customize[/b] their characters with [b]more in-depth body customization[/b] and yes,[b] a brand new species! [/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/4dcf07dc83f97e3076c2e103ab4ca2c93b97f08d.png[/img][i]Roll for Seduction. Work in Progress of the New Dragonborn Species.[/i]

[h1]The Roadmap of Chapter 2[/h1]

Chapter 2 will be kicked off with a [b]MAJOR update on December 4th[/b]. After that, we will sequentially add [b]more and more of the features[/b] and improvements as we closely listen to your feedback.

Check out our Roadmap with a selection (not all!) of  the planned features for the updates of Chapter 2:
[url=https://portal.productboard.com/dungeonfulldive/1-dungeon-full-dive-portal/tabs/2-planned-in-progress][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/28499597d9596ad16704d9406d0f61344c233426.png[/img][/url][i]Visit our Roadmap Page to cast your Vote for Prioritization![/i]

[h1]📅25 days until Chapter 2 Kicks off![/h1]

We’re immensely grateful for your support as we kick off the next milestone in DFD's development road. 
With Chapter 2 we plan to [b]bring the GM experience to the next level[/b] [u]one update at a time[/u]. And while there’s still work to be done, we are incredibly excited to make DFD the best TTRPG experience possible for you!

We haven’t nearly spoiled everything yet, though! Stay tuned as we reveal more content, [b]insights, and in-depth dev blogs in the coming days[/b] and weeks as we reveal the full depth of Chapter 2. Until then:

[h1]Get ready for December the 4th[/h1]

[b]See you inside DFD![/b]

[h3]Discuss this update on Discord[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/e8FznWcyxk][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42258170/d776b95ce3951c6b6035941e94c532768f156bd1.gif[/img][/url]

Greetings Adventurers! 
The time has finally come to journey back into our fantastical realm!

All Kickstarter backers are invited to the exclusive Multiplayer Playtest happening over the weekend from Saturday, June 17th to Sunday, June 18th. As a special thank you, for backers at the Adventurer Tier and above, the journey begins even earlier, starting on Thursday, June 15th! We're excited to have you onboard! 

Gather your party, or use our brand-new LFG Discord Section (https://discord.gg/4PX7SUU5UB) to find other players and dive into your dream journey made of dragons, taverns, and drunk barbarians!

If you participated in our previous Alpha playtest and received a Steam Key, all you need to do is update the game on Steam and dive in!

For those who have not yet received a key, keep an eye on your mailbox on Saturday - we'll be sending them out just in time for the weekend (We will make a separate announcement before we send out the keys)

https://dungeonfulldive.com/home#community

We're grateful for the unwavering support from our Kickstarter backers since the inception of our project. We are providing them with the first glimpse into the new playtest to show our appreciation. notes.title: Dungeon Full Dive Devlog #1: Lip Sync and Eye Blinking
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers! 

Welcome to our first Devlog update! Today’s topics will be Lip Sync and Eye Blinking!

We recently implemented Lip Sync and Eye Blinking for all the characters created via our Character Editor. As a result, you will now have even more immersive sessions and feel part of your fantasy worlds!

[h3]How Lip Sync and Eye Blinking work[/h3]

Whenever you use voice chat, your DfD character will pick up your voice and starts moving their mouth accordingly to the duration of your speech. Additionally, your character will automatically begin blinking and looking around at the beautiful worlds you’ve built (and the ones to come)!

In the future, we are considering to start working on the Eye Blinking feature details so that your character will pick up the current world’s highlights, to have an always more immersive experience for all of you to enjoy!

[h3]Why we added Lip Sync and Eye Blinking[/h3]

We are incredibly excited to introduce these features, as our goal is to recreate the same social experience you would feel in your average DnD session. With these features, your roleplaying experience will be as immersive as it has ever been! Watching other players’ mouths and eyes moving accordingly to their actions will make you feel like you are in the same fantasy world you created with them!

notes.title: The Closed Alpha is coming! + Win some Alpha Keys! – Developer Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, Travelers! [/b][/h3]

The year is coming to an end, and the Christmas season is calling. An eventful year lies behind us and we would like to thank you once again for all the support you have shown us. 2023 will not only be a more than thrilling year full of adventures for us, but also for you: the players. In this regard, we would like to send you off into the new year with anticipation and excitement: 

 
[h3][b]The closed Alpha is coming![/b] [/h3]

We are delighted to tell you that we have scheduled our Alpha playtest: It will take place on the 26.-29. of January! The first playtest for Dungeon Full Dive will be playable via Steam and available for our Kickstarter Backers and late pledgers.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/519/745/60e51c00eb656191d1a387bffdca7eb4_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1671801999&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=969342bafa54fe7c0165bd7f8ac88dfc[/img]
 
What kind of features can you expect in the Alpha? 
 
[list]
[*] [b]Play with your friends [/b]
Jump into the DFD multiplayer with your party, chat with your friends and roll the dice. 
[*] [b]Explore the World from the eyes of your miniature [/b]
Explore the world in VR (or with mouse and keyboard) from the tabletop perspective or jump into your character and interact with a variety of objects right inside your world. 
[*] [b]Edit your Hero [/b]
Try out an early version of the character creator and switch up your style with a first batch of character assets. 
[*] [b]Build your maps [/b]
Build your first maps with the first iteration of the map editor: Browse through assets and place them into your world to make it come alive. (Or scale up your Fighters Longsword to 5m, because everyone needs one of those).
Adjust the lighting and switch from day to night to set the mood.
[/list] 

With our first alpha playtest, we want to give you the chance to provide us with your valuable feedback regarding the mechanics of DFD, as you will be able to test some of the first versions of the core features. 

The alpha playtest is an exclusive early look at the game for our supporters and our first playtest at a large scale. Keep in mind, features are still missing while other might change (based on your feedback) and even though our QA is doing their best job to find every possible bug, there is only so much we can find on our own. So, expect there to be bugs and some rough edges here and there. 

But worry not, we have prepared different ways for you to provide us with your feedback and findings (more on this coming soon) during the alpha. 

However, for the reasons above this first playtest will be under an NDA. This means that you will not be able to show public footage of this early version of Dungeon Full Dive for now. 
[h3]
[b] Haven’t been able to get an alpha key yourself? This is your chance to claim some alpha keys![/b][/h3]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/519/751/bd0344b3144265548a2483f7af223b12_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1671802087&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=3e82cefbaf67e054b1fbb1eeefb6585a[/img]

If you missed the chance to secure yourself an Alpha code (or you want to get additional codes for your party members) head over to our [url=https://twitter.com/DungeonFullDive/status/1606365123752341504]Twitter channel[/url]!  

While you are reading this, we have just started a giveaway where you can snag yourself a package of 5 codes for the Alpha! All you have to do is post the best (or worst?) rendition of your D&D character drawn in Paint (or any other digital drawing software) and you have a chance to win! 

And don’t worry: the winner will not be chosen based on artistic skill. One winner will be chosen at random, while the other will be the community favorite (measured by likes & retweets) - Have fun! 

You can also expect many more teasers of the alpha coming soon, so to never miss any of our updates  head over to our social media channels and sign up to our Newsletter. You can find all of our channels [url=https://linktr.ee/txk_gaming]here[/url].  

In addition, we are currently planning an open beta in 2023, so that even more people can take the opportunity to play the game and send us feedback. Stay tuned for more information on this! 


We also wanted to quickly recap 2022 in this last community update of the year.   


[h3]In 2022... [/h3]

 
... the TxK Gaming family has grown considerably. Our amazing team was able to level up by welcoming additional, talented industry veterans, who all work eagerly to make DFD an even greater experience for you.  

We also owe this to the additional funding for our project, which we received this year from the federal grant for video game developers ("Computerspielförderung"). And so, we are on our best way to provide you with the truly immersive tabletop experience we all are striving for. 

As many of you have probably already seen, Dungeon Full Dive can be found on Steam.  

If you missed this update and want to support us, wishlist DFD on Steam as our release window for mid of 2023 grows closer! (Every wishlist helps us out a ton!) 

 

This wraps up our community recap for the end of 2022. We can't wait to start this exciting new year with you! 

 

Until then, 

The whole TxK Gaming team wishes all of you a happy holiday season and a wonderful start 

into 2023! 🎅 🎆 

 

~Your TxK Gaming Team
